reasons: budget regression on all_categorical: min_average_precision 0.15 met by the baseline (0.1693) but not the candidate (0.1490)

preregistration.expected_outcome:
Uncertain, decided by one borderline budget. On the development seeds flag F1 on
all_categorical improved by +0.12 (95% CI +0.08 to +0.16, Holm p 0.0002) with no
false-positive, over-flag or stability regression, but average precision fell from 0.166
to 0.149 against the 0.15 budget, which the decision rule counts as a regression. Every
other scenario is identical to the baseline by construction. If confirmation puts the
candidate's average precision at or above 0.15, it outperforms; if not, it does not.
preregistration.hypothesis:
On data whose kept columns are all categorical or boolean, unanimity flags almost none of
the anomalies even when the ranking is reasonable. Switching to the equal-weight composite
there, and only there, improves flag F1 on all_categorical; on every other scenario the
rule runs the baseline unchanged.
